title: Longest happy prefix
problemStatement: Master “Longest happy prefix” (Hard Problems) the way an interviewer expects: classify, brute, optimize, prove.
intuition: "Longest happy prefix": clarify alphabet/case; prefer window/hash/KMP over O(n²).

approaches.title: Brute all substrings
Linear pattern (window/hash)
approaches.code:
from collections import Counter
def solve(s):
    left=0; freq=Counter(); best=0
    for r,ch in enumerate(s):
        freq[ch]+=1
        while len(freq)>2:
            freq[s[left]]-=1
            if freq[s[left]]==0: del freq[s[left]]
            left+=1
        best=max(best,r-left+1)
    return best
